w: Swamishri performed the pujan of murti for the Swaminarayan Kutir Mandir in Bhutsar village.
The kishores presented speeches, narrations and expositions on Swamini Vato during Swamishri's puja and meal time.

In the evening assembly, outstanding incidents of volunteers were presented and a skit was performed by the kishores on the subject of whether the country's progress lies in spirituality or modernity. In conclusion, Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Ashokbhai, a new devotee, has firm faith in Satsang. Swamishri blessed him with words of wisdom, “Since you are offering your services here Maharaj will bless you and make you happier physically, mentally and financially. In Satsang one should have a vision of glory for all. Since there is a mass following here someone may tell you off but do not take it to heart. Always keep your focus on God and His Sadhu. One comes here for liberation; otherwise one has physical comforts at home. Do not think of the discomforts here or the fact that someone receives you or not. When you come to the Mandir, do darshan and sit down to listen to discourses. Understand the greatness of all sadhus and devotees.” Then Swamishri narrated the greatness of Parvatbhai in the time of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. “Like Parvatbhai if you are not welcomed or looked after then don’t let your mind fall back from Satsang. Do seva and don’t be overcome by ego.”
Swamishri shed light on how a devotee should walk the path of satsang.

Two devotees asked Swamishri to write his blessings in their diary. Swamishri wrote, “May your satsang remain firm. May you have the habit of following niyam-dharma and agna-upasana, having glory and pure feelings (for all) and an inclination towards listening to discourses and doing bhajan. To dissolve one’s base nature one should look at one’s faults. Be vigilant that one never falls from satsang and find faults in it. Remain in satsang with the spirit of humility and servitude. Perform seva with a feeling of glory. On understanding the glory and divinity of all one will experience peace and happiness. Maharaj will be graceful.”
Swamishri prescribed the elements for progress and happiness in satsang.

No matter how much advancement we have made in science, but we cannot achieve what God has done. He has created humans, animals and birds and made arrangements for their sustenance. If we understand this glory of His then we would not have arrogance and pride. (30 April 2004, London)
Mandir is the birthplace of virtues. By going` there one gets inspiration and peace.
The highest position for a satsangi in the mandir is to offer devotion and do satsang as a humble servant of God. (3 May 2004, London)

Because of spiritual discourses you are emboldened. If there were no discourses then the sense pleasures would drag you away, gamblers would drag you away, drinkers would drag you away and you would be tainted by kusang. (4 May 2004, London)

ds.t: "Only then is there happiness and peace in satsang"
w: Today, while returning after his morning puja, Pramukh Swami Maharaj met an old satsangi on the way. A volunteer had brought him. After serving satsang for years, for some reason he had become inactive.
Chittaranjanbhai said, "Bapa! Do not look at his faults. Forgive his mistake. From now on he will come to satsang."
Swamishri said, "Believe that no mistake has been made at all. Forget whatever has happened and do seva again." Placing a loving hand on his shoulder, Swamishri soothed his remorse.

Swamishri said to him, "To err is human. We come to God and confess our mistake, then we take care that the mistake does not happen again. God takes care of everything. God does not look at anyone's faults. But if we keep remembering our mistakes, we do not get the joy of satsang. So forget everything, that is, throw it all into the sea. Speak only of divinity and glory. Do not get into other talk. Only then is there happiness and peace in satsang."
Even amid the busyness of many tasks, Pramukh Swami Maharaj nurtures the feelings of devotees. He has offered his entire life to God for the sake of the devotees.

Today, extremely busy with the whole day's activities, Swamishri, after his evening meal and meetings, sat down to read letters. At that time two devotees gave him a diary. They said, "In 1970 Yogi Maharaj also wrote blessings in this. In 1977, when you came, you also wrote blessings. Now please write blessings for our memory so that we remain aware of how we should live our lives."
Swamishri wrote blessings in the diary:

"Blessings to Pujya .......... and .......... and the whole family. May your satsang remain firm. May you keep the qualities of observing rules and dharma, obeying commands and upasana, understanding glory, seeing no faults, and listening to discourses and doing bhajan. To remove your own nature, look at your own mistakes, and while removing your nature, take care that your mind never falls back in satsang and that no dislike arises. Live in satsang with the spirit of a servant. Do seva with an understanding of glory. If you understand the glory of everyone and see divinity, there will be peace and you will be happy. Maharaj will grant that grace.
"With the blessings of Shastri Narayanswarupdas,
"Jai Swaminarayan."

This was Swamishri's landscape of understanding during the day. Today, in very few words, Swamishri seemed to have shown the address of Akshardham. However busy he is, whatever he is doing, Swamishri keeps instilling these feelings in everyone's life.

A student staying at the BAPS Chhatralay in Surat pledged before Swamishri that he would do tilak-chandlo daily. Then he expressed his problem, “Before, I used to do tilak-chandlo on a daily basis. But when the professors and others started teasing me I gave up doing it.”

Swamishri advised, “Let people tease you. You should not react against them. People tease but when you do not react they will get bored and stop pestering you in a few days. So you should not be afraid in doing tilak-chandlo. Since you are a devotee do it properly. By doing tilak-chandlo you are not causing trouble to others. So do not flinch from doing it.”

During the meetings, a student from Mordevi who studies at the Surat hostel took a vow before Pramukh Swami Maharaj that from today he would apply chandlo regularly. Expressing his dilemma, he said, "Earlier I used to apply tilak chandlo regularly, but when I came to college, everyone from the professors onwards began teasing me, and since then I had stopped."

Swamishri said, "People will tease. We should not oppose them. People speak to tease, but if we do not answer back, within two or three days they get tired of it. So we should not be afraid of applying tilak chandlo. Since we have become devotees, we should apply tilak chandlo proudly. How does applying tilak chandlo trouble the other person? So do not feel any hesitation about it."

Mahant Swami Maharaj sat on his bed to go to sleep.
A few days earlier, a child's problem had been put before Swamishri: "In the womb, the umbilical cord has wrapped around the baby's neck... the doctor says to operate, so what should we do?"
Swamishri had blessed them, saying, "It will be all right."
Now, as he was going to sleep, Swamishri asked about it: "What happened about that?"
Shrutipriyadas Swami said, "We will ask tomorrow morning and let you know."
Every prayer made before Swamishri stays on his record. This is his closeness to his devotees.

Then the attendants began to tell of incidents in which Swamishri had used his divine power and made such impossible things possible. At the end, Hariprakashdas Swami said, "You have let your divine power loose, haven't you?"
Swamishri said, "We pray so that the poor devotees do not suffer."
Swamishri implied that he does use his divine power, but only for his devotees.
